ruleToc.chapterList:
<js>
var datax = null;
var allChapters = [];
var finalJsonOutput = null;
var inputString = baseUrl;
var parts = inputString.split(',');
var url = parts[0].trim();
try {
    var xDataRegex = /x-data="[^"]*Login\(\d+,\s*'([^']+)'/;
    var match = result.match(xDataRegex);
    if (match && match[1]) {
        datax = match[1];
    } else {
        java.log("未能从源码中匹配并提取到 x-data token");
        throw new Error("XSRF token not found"); // Token 是必须的
    }
    var urlWithXsrf = url + "?_xsrf=" + encodeURIComponent(datax);
    var cookie = "85_ID=" + java.getCookie(url, "85_ID");
    var baseHeaders = {
        "User-Agent": "Mozilla/5.0 (Linux; Android 14; 2312DRAABC) AppleWebKit/537.36 (KHTML, like Gecko) Chrome/132.0.0.0 Mobile Safari/537.36",
        "Content-Type": "application/json;charset=UTF-8",
        "Referer": url,
        "Accept": "application/json, text/plain",
        "Cookie": cookie
    };
    var slices = [];
    var selectContentRegex = /<select class="[^"]*select-primary[^"]*"[^>]*>([\s\S]*?)<\/select>/;
    var selectMatch = result.match(selectContentRegex);
    if (selectMatch && selectMatch[1]) {
        var optionsHtml = selectMatch[1];
        var sliceRegex = /(\d+)\s*~\s*(\d+)/g;
        var sliceMatch;
        while ((sliceMatch = sliceRegex.exec(optionsHtml)) !== null) {
            var start = parseInt(sliceMatch[1], 10);
            var end = parseInt(sliceMatch[2], 10);
            if (!isNaN(start) && !isNaN(end)) {
                slices.push([start, end]);
            }
        }
    }
    if (slices.length === 0) {
        java.log("未能提取到任何章节 Slice，将尝试获取默认范围 [1, 200]");
        slices = [
            [1, 200]
        ];
    }
    java.log("将要处理的 Slices: " + JSON.stringify(slices));
    for (var i = 0; i < slices.length; i++) {
        var currentSlice = slices[i];
        // java.log("准备获取 Slice: " + currentSlice.join(' ~ '));
        var maxAttempts = 3;
        var success = false;
        for (var attempt = 1; attempt <= maxAttempts; attempt++) {
            java.log("尝试获取 Slice " + currentSlice.join('~') + " (第 " + attempt + "/" + maxAttempts + " 次)");
            var jsonString = null;
            try {
                var bodyPayload = {
                    "action": "chapters",
                    "slice": currentSlice
                };
                var op = {
                    "body": JSON.stringify(bodyPayload),
                    "method": "post",
                    "headers": baseHeaders
                };
                var requestString = urlWithXsrf + "," + JSON.stringify(op);
                jsonString = java.ajax(requestString);
                if (jsonString && (jsonString.trim().startsWith('{') || jsonString.trim().startsWith('['))) {
                    var jsonObject = JSON.parse(jsonString);
                    if (jsonObject && jsonObject.result && Array.isArray(jsonObject.result.chapters)) {
                        var fetchedCount = jsonObject.result.chapters.length;
                        allChapters = allChapters.concat(jsonObject.result.chapters);
                        // java.log("成功获取 Slice " + currentSlice.join('~') + " (第 " + attempt + " 次尝试): 本次获取 " + fetchedCount + " 章, 累计 " + allChapters.length + " 章");
                        java.log("成功获取 Slice " + currentSlice.join('~') + " (第 " + attempt + " 次尝试)");
                        success = true;
                        break;
                    } else {
                        java.log("第 " + attempt + " 次尝试: Slice " + currentSlice.join('-') + " 的 JSON 响应格式不正确或未包含 chapters 数组: " + jsonString.substring(0, 200));
                    }
                } else {
                    java.log("第 " + attempt + " 次尝试: Slice " + currentSlice.join('-') + " 返回的不是有效的 JSON: " + jsonString.substring(0, 200));
                    java.log("Slice " + currentSlice.join('-') + " Raw Response (Attempt " + attempt + "): " + jsonString);
                }
            } catch (ajaxOrParseError) {
                java.log("第 " + attempt + " 次尝试获取或解析 Slice " + currentSlice.join('-') + " 时出错: " + ajaxOrParseError);
            }
            if (!success && attempt < maxAttempts) {
                var retryDelay = 4000;
                java.log("等待 " + retryDelay + "ms 后重试...");

                Packages.java.lang.Thread.sleep(retryDelay);
            } else if (!success && attempt === maxAttempts) {

                java.log("已达到最大尝试次数 (" + maxAttempts + ")，放弃获取 Slice 重新搜索过下cf试试" + currentSlice.join('~'));
            }
        }
        if (i < slices.length - 1) {
            java.log("等待2500ms");
            Packages.java.lang.Thread.sleep(2500);
        }
    }
    var combinedResult = {
        "code": 0,
        "result": {
            "code": 1,
            "chapters": allChapters
        }
    };
    finalJsonOutput = JSON.stringify(combinedResult);

} catch (e) {
    java.log("处理目录 JS 规则时发生顶层错误: " + e);
    finalJsonOutput = null;
}
result = finalJsonOutput; 
</js>

exploreRule.bookList:
<js>
function getBookIdFull(url) {
	const {java} = this
	$ = JSON.parse(url).data
	if ($.book_shelf_info != 0 && $.book_shelf_info != undefined) {
		arr = $.book_shelf_info.map($ => $.book_id)
	} else if (list = $.data_list != 0 && $.data_list != undefined)  {
		arr = $.data_list.map($ => $.book_id_str)
	} else {
		java.toast("获取 book_id 失败，你可能需要登录！")
	}
	return arr
}
let ck = "sessionid=" + (String(cookie.getKey("fanqienovel.com", "sessionid")) ? String(cookie.getKey("fanqienovel.com", "sessionid")) : (source.getLoginInfoMap() ? source.getLoginInfoMap() : {})['手动登录Token'])

getShelf = () => {
let book_shelf_url = 'https://fanqienovel.com/reading/bookapi/bookshelf/info/v:version/?aid=1967&iid=0&version_code=57700&update_version_code=57700'
let book_shelf_info = java.ajax(book_shelf_url + ', ' + JSON.stringify({
  headers: {
    'Cookie': ck
  }
}))

bid = getBookIdFull(book_shelf_info)
let id_list = splitArray(bid, 100)
let urls = []
id_list.forEach(i => {
    urls.push(source.bookSourceUrl + "/multi-detail?book_id=" + i.join(","))
})

res = java.ajaxAll(urls)

let resp = {book_info: []}
res.forEach(r => {
  resp.book_info = resp.book_info.concat(JSON.parse(r.body()).data)
})

return resp
}

function getByGroupName(name) {
  let book_shelf_url = 'https://fanqienovel.com/reading/bookapi/bookshelf/info/v:version/?aid=1967&iid=0&version_code=57700&update_version_code=57700'

  let book_shelf_info = JSON.parse(java.ajax(book_shelf_url + ', ' + JSON.stringify({
    headers: {
      'Cookie': ck,
    }
  })))
  let group_bookids = {
    "未分组": []
  }
  // java.log(
  book_shelf_info.data.book_shelf_info.forEach(i => {
    if (!group_bookids[i.group_name ? i.group_name : "未分组"]) group_bookids[i.group_name] = []
    group_bookids[i.group_name ? i.group_name : "未分组"].push(i.book_id)
  })
  // java.log(JSON.stringify(group_bookids["未分组"]))
  // java.log(decodeURIComponent(name))
  if (!group_bookids[decodeURIComponent(name)]) return {data: []}
  //java.log("awa")
  let book_ids = splitArray(group_bookids[decodeURIComponent(name)], 100)
  let urls = []

  book_ids.forEach(i => {
    urls.push(source.bookSourceUrl + "/multi-detail?book_id=" + i.join(","))
  })
  
  res = java.ajaxAll(urls)

  let resp = {book_info: []}
  res.forEach(r => {
    resp.book_info = resp.book_info.concat(JSON.parse(r.body()).data)
  })

  return resp
}

function getByTabIndex(index) {
  let url = _mlsec.requestHeader(
	  "bookmall/tab",
    "version_name=5.8.9.32",
	  null,
	  ck
  )
  let all = JSON.parse(java.ajax(url))
  let tab = all.data.tab_item[0].cell_data[index].cell_data
  if (!tab) tab = []
  let bookList = []
  for (let i of tab) {
    bookList = bookList.concat(i.book_data)
    // java.log(JSON.stringify(i.book_data))
  }
  return { book_info: bookList }
}

if (baseUrl.endsWith("bookshelf")) result = getShelf("bookshelf/info")
else {
  let w = baseUrl.split("/")
  if (baseUrl.includes("groupName")) {
    result = getByGroupName(w[w.length - 1])
  } else if (baseUrl.includes("tab")) {
    result = getByTabIndex(parseInt(w[w.length - 1]))
  } else result = JSON.parse(result)
}
JSON.stringify({data: result.book_info || result.data.book_info || result.detail_list || result.data})
</js>
